_comment: OSA config — copy to ~/.osa/config.json. Only the keys shown here are read by OSA; any other key is ignored. Secrets (LLM API keys, channel bot tokens) live in ~/.osa/.env, NOT in this file. See examples/.env.example.
_comment_provider: Active LLM provider and model. 'provider' must be one OSA knows (ollama, anthropic, openai, miosa, openrouter, custom). 'model' is the provider-specific model id. The onboarding wizard and the settings API write these two keys, and they are re-read on restart so your choice persists. The matching API key / base URL go in ~/.osa/.env.
_comment_runtime: Optional runtime settings surfaced by the settings API.
_comment_machines: Composable skill sets. The 'core' machine (file/shell/web tools) is always on and cannot be listed here. Set a machine to true to activate its extra skills and prompt guidance. Read by OptimalSystemAgent.Machines.
_comment_os: Extra directories OSA is allowed to scan when it maps your system. Read by OptimalSystemAgent.OS.Scanner via os.scan_paths.
_comment_budgets: Cost and token guardrails. 'global' applies to everything; add a key named after a specific agent to override it for that agent. Recognized fields: daily_limit_usd, daily_limit_tokens, monthly_limit_usd, monthly_limit_tokens. Read and written by the /budgets API.
_comment_channels: Messaging channels OSA answers on. A channel is treated as 'configured' when its key is present here; the actual bot tokens are read from ~/.osa/.env (see examples/.env.example). Delete a channel key to disable it.
